proof_body:
by
  intro Ω ι _ P _ X m v s hX hI hL
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_zero_var]
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.map_const]; simp
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    have hind : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (X i) (fun ω => ∑ j ∈ s, X j ω) P := by
      have h := (hI.indepFun_finsetSum_of_notMem hX hi).symm
      have e : (∑ j ∈ s, X j) = fun ω => ∑ j ∈ s, X j ω := by funext ω; simp [Finset.sum_apply]
      rwa [e] at h
    simp only [Finset.sum_insert hi]
    exact ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_add_gaussianReal_of_indepFun (P := P) (X := X i) (Y := fun ω => ∑ j ∈ s, X j ω) (m₁ := m i) (m₂ := ∑ j ∈ s, m j) (v₁ := v i) (v₂ := ∑ j ∈ s, v j) hind (hL i) ih
target_source: ∀ (Ω ι : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (m : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → NNReal) (s : Finset ι), (∀ i, Measurable (X i)) → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P → (∀ i, P.map (X i) = ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (m i) (v i)) → P.map (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) = ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (∑ i ∈ s, m i) (∑ i ∈ s, v i)
